data.value:

You assume the risk (game updates may break mods or the manager; backups are recommended). The author and related parties are not liable for any direct or indirect losses arising from use of this manager or from obtaining, installing, enabling, or managing any third-party mods / plugins / related files through it. 5. Third-party mods are provided by their authors; the manager and catalog maintainer do not guarantee safety, legality, or quality. Enable at your own risk. Report issues by email. 6. Catalog listing is not an endorsement; the maintainer may refuse, delay, edit metadata, or remove entries. 7. Contact: email llxmod@foxmail.com (mods / reports / feedback); QQ 319323959 (maintainer "院长大人") as secondary. 8. Continued use means you accept this notice. If you do not agree, stop using and uninstall immediately.

data.name: ReportConfirm
data.value: This opens your email client to send a report to llxmod@foxmail.com (body copied to clipboard as backup). False reports may affect review. Continue?

data.name: ReportSuccess
data.value: Opened your email client; report body copied to clipboard. Send to llxmod@foxmail.com. If no mail app opens, paste the body into a new message yourself.

data.name: ReportFailed
data.value: Could not open the email client

data.name: SubmitModConfirm
data.value: Open your email client to submit to llxmod@foxmail.com?

data.name: SubmitModSuccess
data.value: Email client opened. Fill the template, attach .dll (optional preview.png), and send to llxmod@foxmail.com.

data.name: SubmitModFailed
data.value: Could not open the email client

data.name: SubmitMailOpenedDomestic
data.value: Copied subject & body; opened QQ Mail web — create a new message, paste, attach files, and send to llxmod@foxmail.com.

data.name: SubmitMailOpenedInternational
data.value: Copied subject & body; opened Gmail compose — attach .dll (optional preview.png) and send to llxmod@foxmail.com.

data.name: ReportMailOpenedDomestic
data.value: Copied subject & body; opened QQ Mail web — create a new message, paste, and send the report to llxmod@foxmail.com.

data.name: ReportMailOpenedInternational
data.value: Copied subject & body; opened Gmail compose — review and send the report to llxmod@foxmail.com.

data.name: MailOpenFailed
data.value: Could not open webmail; subject & body were copied. Please email llxmod@foxmail.com manually and paste.

data.name: SubmitGuideBody
data.value: Subject must start with one of these prefixes (copy-paste): • [Mod投稿/Submit] new mod • [Mod更新/Update] update existing • [Mod举报/Report] report • [管理器建议/Feedback] feedback One email = one request. Maintainers review and upload to the catalog — no Fork/PR required. (Advanced users may still open a PR.)

data.name: SubmitGuideTip
data.value: After you continue, the manager copies the template and opens QQ Mail (Chinese UI) or Gmail compose (other languages). Paste, attach .dll (optional preview.png), and send. If attachments are huge (~>40MB), put a netdisk link in the body. Do not send source unless asked.

data.name: SubmitGuideOpen
data.value: Open full guide / 打开完整教程

data.name: SubmitGuideOpenEmail
data.value: Open submit email / 打开发送投稿邮件

data.name: SubmitGuideWaitNotice
data.value: The maintainer will review and process your message within a reasonable time. Handling may be briefly delayed due to daily life and personal schedule; thank you for your patience. Please do not resend the same request.
